changes.title: All comparisons reachable
changes.text: Run and group comparisons now include every eligible record through compact pages instead of stopping at the first 40.

changes.title: Seed-floor memory
changes.text: Removed temporary objects from seed-floor row assembly without changing recorded or canonical values.

changes.title: Comparison-page checks
changes.text: Added page-boundary coverage and Android touch checks for later comparisons, previous pages and the final record.

changes.title: Audit and delivery evidence
changes.text: Recorded verified delivery and the current partial UIMSD audit, including storage checks and measured allocation savings.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I made older run and group comparisons reachable without loading every choice onto the screen. I also removed unnecessary seed-floor allocations while preserving the statistics.
